about.heroDesc: VTEKE is a leading manufacturer of industrial electrical solutions, delivering reliable power systems to 30 countries worldwide with uncompromising quality and innovation.
about.overviewDesc: VTEKE is a certified manufacturer of industrial low-voltage electrical equipment, delivering precision-engineered solutions to more than 35 countries worldwide. Specializing in current transformers (CTs), electronic protection relays, digital panel meters, and energy analyzers, VTEKE serves electrical panel builders, distributors, and industrial automation professionals who require accuracy, reliability, and long-term performance.
